metadata.description: Cross-platform Claude Code and Codex plugin marketplace. Publishes pionless-agent (coding-workflow agents) and pionless-deep-research (research orchestrator + leaf agents + report-style skills).

plugins.name: pionless-agent
plugins.description: Coding-workflow agents: hoah-coder (focused coder with built-in reviewer loop), parallel-fix (batch issue fixer with isolated worktree workers), socratic-tutor, freshwater-doctor.

plugins.name: pionless-deep-research
plugins.description: Deep-research orchestrator (skill-shell) with leaf craft agents (worker, verifier, drafter, writer), 6 report-style skills (technical-paper, position-paper, executive-briefing, landscape-scan, design-to-do, tutorial), and a markdown-to-PDF pipeline.

plugins.name: solo-ralph
plugins.description: Self-driving Ralph Loop: one command drives a vague goal through hard-req → spec → todo, then launches a fresh-subprocess loop that executes the todo until done. Loop survives session exit via nohup+disown.
